description: Enterprise cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform providing comprehensive sales, service, marketing, and custom application development capabilities.
auth_methods: OAuth 2.0 (WebServer, User-Agent, JWT Bearer, SAML Assertion)
api_breadth: Extensive enterprise coverage supporting standard and custom objects, metadata management, bulk data sync, real-time event streaming, and custom Apex REST/SOAP endpoints.
mcp_evidence: Salesforce provides official Hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers allowing AI agents to securely query and interact with Salesforce environments, documented under developer.salesforce.com.
blocker: Navigating complex enterprise permission sets, API governor limits, connected app security configurations, and Salesforce edition/licensing requirements.

evidence.title: Hosted MCP Servers Overview
evidence.excerpt: Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers provide a secure way to connect AI assistants and agents to Salesforce data and metadata.

evidence.title: Hosted MCP Servers Reference
evidence.supports: Official MCP server reference and lifecycle status
evidence.excerpt: Reference documentation for Salesforce Hosted MCP server tools, endpoints, and integration requirements.

evidence.title: Salesforce REST and SOAP API Developer Guide
evidence.excerpt: Salesforce APIs include REST, SOAP, Bulk API, GraphQL, and Streaming API supporting OAuth 2.0 and session authentication.

research_notes: Free Developer Edition orgs provide full access for testing APIs and Hosted MCP servers, but production use is strictly governed by enterprise licensing tiers, Connected App policies, and governor limits.
